name: Universal CityWalk Hollywood
summary: Universal CityWalk Hollywood is a high-energy entertainment complex featuring an exciting mix of shops, restaurants, bars, and a 7-story IMAX theater. Located adjacent to Universal Studios, this open-air destination offers a vibrant atmosphere that blends retail, dining, and entertainment in the heart of Los Angeles.
demographics: Universal CityWalk Hollywood attracts a diverse mix of tourists and locals, with a strong representation of families with children and young adults aged 18-34 seeking entertainment experiences. The visitor base includes middle to upper-middle income households drawn to the theme park adjacent location, as well as international tourists who represent a significant portion of foot traffic. Shopping patterns emphasize entertainment, dining, and experiential retail over traditional shopping, with visitors typically spending several hours combining retail with movies, restaurants, and nightlife activities.
description: Universal CityWalk Hollywood is an iconic entertainment and retail destination located at 100 Universal City Plaza, serving as the vibrant gateway to Universal Studios Hollywood. This high-energy outdoor complex seamlessly blends shopping, dining, and entertainment into an immersive experience that captures the spirit of Los Angeles. The center features a dynamic mix of retail stores, diverse restaurants ranging from casual eateries to upscale dining establishments, and entertainment venues including a spectacular 7-story IMAX theater. With its distinctive architecture, neon-lit streetscape, and pedestrian-friendly layout, CityWalk has become a destination in its own right, attracting both theme park visitors and locals seeking world-class entertainment. The center's strategic location in the heart of the entertainment capital makes it a must-visit destination that combines the excitement of Hollywood with convenient access to shopping and dining experiences.
